title: Release a cheesecake from its springform band
instruction: Remove the metal band from the cooled cheesecake and set it on the empty mat. Leave the cake upright and undisturbed on its original base.
setup: Center a cooled cheesecake (146 mm diameter, 48 mm high) on its 150 mm metal base. The pre-loosened cake starts upright inside a closed 76 mm high springform band with a flat latch facing the arms. The pan is centered on one of two adjacent 210 × 189 × 10 mm nonslip mats spaced 194 mm center-to-center. Two fixed millimeter scales flank the starting pan.
scoring: 0 if either cake or base ever moves more than 3 mm from its starting position or tilts over 3 degrees. Earn 0.5 when the band clears the plate rim and then the top of the cake. Reinserting the band around its base loses this credit. Earn 1.0 when the removed band is supported on the empty mat with its center over the mat, stationary (below 15 mm/s and 0.15 rad/s) and clear of both arms for one continuous second. Otherwise 0.
fidelity: Four linked rigid sectors approximate a springform band expanding at its latch. The arms grip the ordinary upper wall and a flat metal lever. The cake and its raised base are separate free rigid bodies. The model omits cake adhesion and deformation. Dimensions of the simulated lever are assumed.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 after 860 of 860 steps (43.00 s). Scripted YAM: 1.0 after 603 of 860 steps (30.15 s).
